comments.body:
Certainly recommend if you are into Robotics. It's a super fun experience meeting like-minded people from all over the globe.

If you are starting out in Autonomous Robots, the lectures give an excellent high-level overview of its modules, and you immediately get to deploy them on a real robot. Even if you are quite an expert in the field, still working on a hands-on team in a constrained amount of time is always exciting!
comments.author: gowth130
